2504: 		 * 							thumbnails should be written to.
2505: 		 * @param rename			The rename function which is used to
2506: 		 * 							determine the filenames of the thumbnail
2507: 		 * 							files to write.
2508: 		 * @return					A list of {@link File}s of the thumbnails
2509: 		 * 							which were created.
2510: 		 * @throws IOException		If a problem occurs while reading the
2511: 		 * 							original images or writing the thumbnails
2512: 		 * 							to files.
2513: 		 * @throws IllegalStateException		If the original images are not
2514: 		 * 										from files.
2515: 		 * @throws IllegalArgumentException		If the destination directory
2516: 		 * 										is not a directory.
2517: 		 * @since 	0.4.7
2518: 		 */
2519: 		public List<File> asFiles(File destinationDir, Rename rename) throws IOException {
2520: 			checkReadiness();
2521: 			
2522: 			if (rename == null) {
2523: 				throw new NullPointerException("Rename is null.");
2524: 			}
2525: 			
2526: 			if (destinationDir != null && !destinationDir.isDirectory()) {
2527: 				throw new IllegalArgumentException("Given destination is not a directory.");
2528: 			}
2529: 
2530: 			List<File> destinationFiles = new ArrayList<File>();
2531: 			
2532: 			for (ImageSource<T> source : sources) {
2533: 				if (!(source instanceof FileImageSource)) {
2534: 					throw new IllegalStateException("Cannot create thumbnails to files if original images are not from files.");
2535: 				}
2536: 				
2537: 				ThumbnailParameter param = makeParam();
2538: 				
2539: 				File f = ((FileImageSource)source).getSource();
2540: 				
2541: 				File actualDestDir = destinationDir == null ? f.getParentFile() : destinationDir;
2542: 				File destinationFile = new File(actualDestDir, rename.apply(f.getName(), param));
2543: 				
2544: 				FileImageSink destination = new FileImageSink(destinationFile, allowOverwrite);
2545: 				
2546: 				try {
2547: 					Thumbnailator.createThumbnail(
2548: 							new SourceSinkThumbnailTask<T, File>(param, source, destination)
2549: 					);
2550: 					
2551: 					destinationFiles.add(destination.getSink());
2552: 
2553: 				} catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
2554: 					/*
2555: 					 * Handle the IllegalArgumentException which is thrown when
2556: 					 * the destination file already exists by not adding the
2557: 					 * current file to the destinationFiles list.
2558: 					 */
2559: 				}
2560: 			}
2561: 			
2562: 			return destinationFiles;
2563: 		}
2564: 
2565: 		/**
2566: 		 * Creates thumbnails and stores them to files using the
2567: 		 * {@link Rename} function to determine the filenames.
2568: 		 * <p>
2569: 		 * When the destination file exists, and overwriting files has been
2570: 		 * disabled by calling the {@link #allowOverwrite(boolean)} method
2571: 		 * with {@code false}, then the thumbnail with the destination file
2572: 		 * already existing will not be written.
2573: 		 * <p>
2574: 		 * To call this method, the thumbnails must have been creates from
2575: 		 * files by calling the {@link Thumbnails#of(File...)} method.
2576: 		 * 
2577: 		 * @param rename			The rename function which is used to
2578: 		 * 							determine the filenames of the thumbnail
2579: 		 * 							files to write.
2580: 		 * @throws IOException		If a problem occurs while reading the
2581: 		 * 							original images or writing the thumbnails
2582: 		 * 							to files.
2583: 		 * 							thumbnails to files.
2584: 		 * @throws IllegalStateException		If the original images are not
2585: 		 * 										from files.
2586: 		 * @since 	0.3.7
2587: 		 */
2588: 		public void toFiles(Rename rename) throws IOException {
2589: 			toFiles(null, rename);
2590: 		}
2591: 		
2592: 		/**
2593: 		 * Creates thumbnails and stores them to files in the directory
2594: 		 * specified by the given {@link File} object, and using the
2595: 		 * {@link Rename} function to determine the filenames.
2596: 		 * <p>
2597: 		 * When the destination file exists, and overwriting files has been
2598: 		 * disabled by calling the {@link #allowOverwrite(boolean)} method
2599: 		 * with {@code false}, then the thumbnail with the destination file
2600: 		 * already existing will not be written.
2601: 		 * <p>
2602: 		 * Extra caution should be taken when using this method, as there are
2603: 		 * no protections in place to prevent file name collisions resulting
2604: 		 * from creating thumbnails from files in separate directories but
2605: 		 * having the same name. In such a case, the behavior will be depend
2606: 		 * on the behavior of the {@link #allowOverwrite(boolean)} as
2607: 		 * described in the previous paragraph.
2608: 		 * <p>
2609: 		 * To call this method, the thumbnails must have been creates from
2610: 		 * files by calling the {@link Thumbnails#of(File...)} method.
2611: 		 * 
2612: 		 * @param destinationDir	The destination directory to which the
2613: 		 * 							thumbnails should be written to.
2614: 		 * @param rename			The rename function which is used to
2615: 		 * 							determine the filenames of the thumbnail
2616: 		 * 							files to write.
2617: 		 * @throws IOException		If a problem occurs while reading the
2618: 		 * 							original images or writing the thumbnails
2619: 		 * 							to files.
2620: 		 * 							thumbnails to files.
2621: 		 * @throws IllegalStateException		If the original images are not
2622: 		 * 										from files.
2623: 		 * @throws IllegalArgumentException		If the destination directory
2624: 		 * 										is not a directory.
2625: 		 * @since 	0.4.7
2626: 		 */
2627: 		public void toFiles(File destinationDir, Rename rename) throws IOException {
2628: 			asFiles(destinationDir, rename);
2629: 		}
2630: 
2631: 		/**
2632: 		 * Create a thumbnail and writes it to a {@link File}.
2633: 		 * <p>
2634: 		 * When the destination file exists, and overwriting files has been
2635: 		 * disabled by calling the {@link #allowOverwrite(boolean)} method
2636: 		 * with {@code false}, then an {@link IllegalArgumentException} will
2637: 		 * be thrown.
2638: 		 * <p>
2639: 		 * To call this method, the thumbnail must have been created from a
2640: 		 * single source.
2641: 		 * 
2642: 		 * @param outFile			The file to which the thumbnail is to be
2643: 		 * 							written to.
2644: 		 * @throws IOException		If a problem occurs while reading the
2645: 		 * 							original images or writing the thumbnails
2646: 		 * 							to files.
2647: 		 * @throws IllegalArgumentException		If multiple original image files
2648: 		 * 										are	specified, or if the
2649: 		 * 										destination file exists, and
2650: 		 * 										overwriting files is disabled.
2651: 		 */
2652: 		public void toFile(File outFile) throws IOException {
2653: 			checkReadiness();
2654: 			
2655: 			Iterator<ImageSource<T>> iter = sources.iterator();
2656: 			ImageSource<T> source = iter.next();
2657: 			
2658: 			if (iter.hasNext()) {
2659: 				throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cannot output multiple thumbnails to one file.");
